notes: Every metric here is backed by exactly one query manifest in infrastructure/openobserve/analytics/queries/ (see queryId) — this catalog documents the metric's meaning and safety contract; the query manifest documents the SQL that computes it. See docs/openobserve-query-dashboard-governance.md for the full empty-data/cardinality/time-range rules these entries follow.

'0 != NO_DATA': a metric whose query is a plain COUNT with no matching rows legitimately returns 0 (a real zero), not NO_DATA. A ratio metric whose denominator is 0 returns SQL NULL (via a CASE/NULLIF guard, verified in docs/openobserve-v0.91-dashboard-capabilities.md capability #15/#16) and must be rendered/interpreted as NO_DATA, never coerced to 0. A query execution error (non-200, or a caught SQL error) must never be displayed as 0 or NO_DATA — it is its own distinct state.

No metric here claims or depends on guaranteed delivery, storage, or purge behavior — see docs/telemetry-delivery-security-decision.md (Stage 13) and docs/session-replay-security-decision.md (Stage 11); these metrics only ever describe what OpenObserve has actually ingested and can currently query.

alertReady fields are placeholder metadata only (Stage 17 scope) — see docs/openobserve-query-dashboard-governance.md "Stage 17 alert-ready boundary". No alert is created, evaluated, or threshold-enforced by this stage.

metrics.description: Distinct RUM sessions observed for the selected service/environment/version.
metrics.eventScope: any record type (session_id is present on every _rumdata record)
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: Zero matching sessions renders as a real 0 (COUNT DISTINCT with no GROUP BY always returns exactly one row); this is a legitimate zero, not NO_DATA.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate, no group-by.

metrics.description: Count of view events for the selected service/environment/version.
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: Zero matching views renders as a real 0; this is a legitimate zero, not NO_DATA.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate, no group-by.

metrics.description: Fraction of sessions that produced at least one error event.
metrics.eventScope: any record type for the denominator; type = 'error' for the numerator
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: denominator = 0 (no sessions at all) -> NO_DATA (SQL NULL via a CASE guard, not 0 and not a rendered ratio). denominator > 0 and numerator = 0 -> a real 0.0 rate, not NO_DATA.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate, no group-by.

metrics.description: Error event volume normalized against view volume.
metrics.eventScope: type = 'error' for the numerator; type = 'view' for the denominator
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: denominator = 0 (no views) -> NO_DATA (SQL NULL via a CASE guard), even if the numerator is > 0 — a rate with no view base is not a meaningful 0 or a computable rate. denominator > 0 and numerator = 0 -> a real 0.0 rate.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate, no group-by.

metrics.description: Fraction of resource events with an HTTP failure status (>= 400) or a native network failure (status 0).
metrics.numerator: count(*) where type = 'resource' and (resource_status_code >= 400 or resource_status_code = 0)
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: denominator = 0 (no resource events) -> NO_DATA. denominator > 0 and numerator = 0 -> a real 0.0 rate.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate, no group-by.

metrics.description: Browser log record volume grouped by log level/status (low-cardinality: a small fixed set of levels).
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: No matching log records -> an empty result set (zero rows), not a row with a 0 value — the panel/table renders as empty, which callers must distinguish from a query error.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — status/level is a small, bounded enum (info/warn/error/...), grouped with a LIMIT as defense in depth.

metrics.description: LCP percentiles across views, plus the sample count the percentiles were computed over.
metrics.eventScope: type = 'view' and view_largest_contentful_paint is not null
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: sample_count = 0 -> NO_DATA for all three percentiles (OpenObserve's percentile functions return SQL NULL over zero rows, verified), never rendered as 0ns.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate row, no group-by.

metrics.description: CLS percentiles across views, plus the sample count the percentiles were computed over.
metrics.eventScope: type = 'view' and view_cumulative_layout_shift is not null
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: sample_count = 0 -> NO_DATA for all three percentiles, never rendered as 0.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate row, no group-by.

metrics.description: INP percentiles across views, plus the sample count the percentiles were computed over.
metrics.eventScope: type = 'view' and view_interaction_to_next_paint is not null
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: sample_count = 0 -> NO_DATA for all three percentiles, never rendered as 0ns.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate row, no group-by.

metrics.description: Age of the most recently observed _rumdata record for the selected service/environment, measured at read time by the caller (max(_timestamp) subtracted from the current time) — not a native OpenObserve field.
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: No matching records in the query window -> SQL NULL for max(_timestamp) -> NO_DATA (freshness is undefined, never rendered as age 0 or as 'now').
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate, no group-by.

metrics.description: Age of the most recently observed _rumlog record for the selected service/environment, measured at read time by the caller (max(_timestamp) subtracted from the current time) — not a native OpenObserve field.
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: No matching records in the query window -> SQL NULL for max(_timestamp) -> NO_DATA.
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW — single scalar aggregate, no group-by.

metrics.description: Sessions and error-session counts broken down per deployed version, for spotting a regression introduced by a specific release.
metrics.eventScope: any record type for sessions; type = 'error' for the error-session count
metrics.numerator: count(distinct session_id) where type = 'error', grouped by version
metrics.emptyDataSemantics: No matching records -> an empty result set (zero rows), not a row with 0/NO_DATA values. Within a returned row, a version with 0 sessions cannot occur (a version only appears in the grouping if it has at least one session).
metrics.cardinalityRisk: LOW-TO-BOUNDED — version is a low-cardinality field in practice (a handful of live deployments at once), but the query still applies LIMIT 20 as defense in depth against an unexpectedly high version cardinality.
